meta.title: PRAVAAH — Traffic Decision Intelligence, Jaipur
meta.description: Continuous, classified, corridor-level traffic measurement for Jaipur. Counts and composition, not just delay.

home.headline: The instrument that measures Jaipur
home.standfirst: Jaipur runs 35 lakh vehicles on a network it cannot measure. PRAVAAH turns feeds the state already owns into counts, classifications, forecasts and policy evidence.
home.chooseDirectionHelp: Three directions over the same components and the same data. Switch between them, and between light and dark, to compare.

design.galleryTitle: Three directions, one dashboard, live data
design.galleryStandfirst: The same components, the same corridor, the same moment — rendered three ways in both themes. Pick one and it goes to full depth.
design.apiUnavailable: The API is not reachable. Start it with `make api`.

blurb.instrument: The spec'd thesis. Araish plaster and basalt, brass as the only accent, engraved rules. An instrument that shows its own scale.
blurb.control: Same thesis, operations-floor density. Tighter type, faster motion, more panes on a wall display.
blurb.editorial: Magazine-grade and warmer. Sindoor accent, generous whitespace, oversized Devanagari. Loses the instrument argument.

quality.label: Data quality
quality.certificate: Validated at {day} in daylight, {night} at night, per camera.
quality.provisional: Provisional — measured against public Indian datasets, not yet against Jaipur video.
quality.simulatedExplain: Derived from synthetic records. Volumes are simulated on a profile calibrated to published TomTom measurements for Jaipur.

arc.title: The corridor's day, on a calibrated arc
arc.summary: Congestion peaks at {peakIndex} out of 100 at {peakTime}. It is currently {nowIndex}.

dashboard.modelCorridorNote: Tonk Road, Yaadgaar to Sanganer, is the state's own declared first Model Traffic Corridor from the April 2026 reform plan.
dashboard.classMixNote: Probe data cannot report composition. Every capacity calculation depends on it.

forecast.label: Forecast
forecast.baselineNote: Persistence baseline with an 80% interval. A learned model ships only once it beats this.
